sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: It's time to take your communication to the next level, Taurus. Expand outward and upward. For the last three weeks you've gone through a serious mental process that has helped you define what you stand for and believe in. Now you're in a phase that urges you to put these ideas into motion. The expansive quality of the day is profound, so take advantage of it and get moving.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Take time to beautify your world and the work you produce, dearest Taurus, as Venus rx aligns with the nodes of fate. This energy is all about investing in your home, health, and career to reach your highest potential. A sweet aspect between the Scorpio Sun and Cancer Moon harmonizes your mind, making it easier to let down your guard and connect. Just remember: maintain a healthy level of mystery while Luna squares Saturn.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: A day when rest will be important- As you have been facing lot of mental pressure recently-  Recreation and entertainment will help you relax. Today, you can take your family members out for a get-together and spend a lot of money on them. Your brother will be more supportive to your needs than you had thought. Today you will have the stamina and the know-how to raise your earning power. Today, you will have ample time to spend with your spouse. Your spouse might become insensitive toward your health today.

You may be considering a move of some kind. It can't hurt to do a little research on what it would take to make that happen in a desirable time frame.
